auditAccessNotes: A direct /check-runs/{id} GET was rejected by the connector's endpoint allowlist. The supported /commits/{head}/check-runs collection returned and independently verified every exact identity.

A command to persist the large first check-run response hit the OS argument length limit before process creation. A compact snapshot was then saved; final full raw responses are written in bounded chunks. Neither retrieval/persistence issue affected CI execution or source.
